name: Service Nine
desc: Reliable sidearm. Every 12th trigger deals triple damage, even with Infinite Ammo.
art: a cute chunky sci-fi pistol
lv5: VERDICT — Every 6th shot becomes a piercing tracer that marks enemies.

name: Deadeye
desc: Six-shot hand cannon. Heavy rounds pierce targets; critical hits deal triple damage.
art: a gleaming cowboy revolver with neon trim
lv5: SHOWDOWN — Critical hits stun their target. Precision rewards each chamber.

name: Breacher
desc: Seven-pellet close-range blast. Heavy recoil kicks you backward; deadly up close.
art: a sawed-off double barrel shotgun
lv5: BREACH KICK — Point-blank hits stun and throw enemies backward.

name: Cyclone
desc: Fast automatic fire. Holding the trigger steadily tightens its bullet spread.
art: a compact submachine gun with drum magazine
lv5: SUPPRESSION — Hits send out a slowing shockwave every 0.55 seconds.

name: Vulcan
desc: Spooling minigun. Sustained fire accelerates the barrels but slows your movement.
art: a huge six barrel minigun
lv3: Barrels spool up twice as fast.
lv5: FULL SPOOL — At peak speed, rounds pierce and knock enemies sideways.
lv5_brief: Full Spool: pierce and side push

name: Longshot
desc: Precision rifle. Pierces multiple enemies and deals 2× damage to untouched targets.
art: a long sleek sniper rifle with scope
lv3: A kill fires a free follow-up shot at another target.
lv5: COLLATERAL — Every enemy pierced strengthens the same traveling bullet.

name: Payload
desc: Accelerating, lightly homing rockets detonate on contact, clearing clustered enemies.
art: a chunky rocket launcher with a pink rocket
lv3: Fires an additional rocket each volley.
lv5: THERMOBARIC — Each blast is followed by a delayed vacuum that pulls and slows.

name: Rebound
desc: Bouncing grenades control corridors, then explode over an area.
art: a round cartoon grenade launcher
lv5: SMART BANK — After hitting a wall, a grenade steers toward a nearby enemy.
lv5_brief: Smart Bank: wall bounce seeks foes

name: Prism Beam
desc: Continuous piercing laser. Holding fire builds heat until the beam overheats.
art: a futuristic laser cannon glowing purple
lv3: Projects a second beam while firing.
lv5: PRISMATIC — First contact forks into 2 side rays; firing no longer overheats.

name: Arc Caster
desc: Chain lightning automatically jumps between nearby enemies and applies shock.
art: a tesla coil gun crackling with blue lightning
lv5: STATIC OVERLOAD — Every 3rd chained target is briefly stunned.

name: Cinder
desc: Short-range flame cone burns every enemy it hits. Uses fuel instead of bullets.
art: a flamethrower with a fuel tank
lv5: FLASHOVER — Burning enemies that die ignite up to 3 previously unburned foes.

name: Razor Disc
desc: Piercing discs slice through crowds, then fly back. Catch them to free throw slots.
art: a glowing razor frisbee disc
lv5: VORTEX RECALL — Returning discs pull nearby enemies toward their cutting path.

name: Returner
desc: Heavy curved boomerang hits on its outward and return paths. Catch it to throw again.
art: a wooden boomerang with neon paint
lv5: PERFECT CATCH — Consecutive catches boost the next throw, up to +45% damage.

name: Gauss Lance
desc: Hold fire to charge a penetrating rail strike. Holds 3 charge cells before reloading.
art: a sci-fi railgun with blue energy coils
lv3: Each rail strike charges twice as fast.
lv5: ION SCAR — Rail strikes leave a damaging lightning corridor for 1.5 seconds.

name: Swarmcaster
desc: Release seeking bees that pursue targets and deliver poison with their stings.
art: a beehive shaped gun with cartoon bees
lv5: PHEROMONES — Stings mark prey so other bees prioritize those enemies.

name: Impact Cannon
desc: Heavy rolling cannonballs fling enemies into one another for collision damage.
art: a cannon that shoots bowling balls
lv5: PERFECT STRIKE — One ball hitting 3 enemies triggers a powerful crowd shove.

name: Rivet Driver
desc: Rapid-fire nails can pin enemies to the ground and interrupt their attacks.
art: a yellow construction nail gun
lv5: RIVET TETHER — A pin can tether and briefly stun another nearby enemy.

name: Fowl Play
desc: Ricocheting chickens bounce between enemies, honk, and explode at the end.
art: a launcher stuffed with rubber chickens
lv5: POULTRY PANIC — A direct hit charms up to 3 nearby enemies against their allies.

name: Pressure Pop
desc: Bubbles trap and immobilize enemies, then pop for area damage.
art: a toy bubble gun with big soap bubbles
lv3: Each bubble can trap up to 3 enemies.
lv5: PRESSURE TRANSFER — When a bubble pops, it can trap another victim twice.

name: Ricochet
desc: Metal balls rebound from the road walls, gaining damage after each wall bounce.
art: a pinball cannon with a shiny steel ball
lv5: PERFECT BANK — Wall rebounds charge a stronger stun and knockback on impact.

name: Hydra Bow
desc: Each bolt splits into 3 weaker fragments on its first impact. Fragments cannot split again.
art: a futuristic crossbow with glowing bolts
lv3: Splits into 5 fragments on first impact.
lv5: HYDRA HUNTERS — Fragments home toward fresh enemies without splitting again.

name: Frostcaster
desc: Snowballs swell and gain damage in flight, building freeze on every hit.
art: a snow cannon shooting snowballs
lv3: Frozen targets shatter, damaging nearby enemies.
lv5: WHITEOUT — The first snowball impact leaves a lingering freezing field.
